combo_label: At the Supermarket × Horses & Riding × Codes & Ciphers

entries.clue: British codename for the intelligence the breaks produced
Headlong four-beat pace, the fastest an animal has in it
Belly strap that stops the saddle slipping; elsewhere, a waistline measurement
Soft flat plastic wallet of wet cat food, torn open at a little notch
Vast out-of-town shed that feeds a hundred branches by nightly lorry
Yard visitor with an anvil in the van, rasp in hand and nails in his mouth
Grown female of the herd; on the Moon, one of the dark lava plains
Dots and dashes tapped out on a key
Wired wheel that steps round after each keypress
Uniformed watcher near the exit, alert to pockets and unpaid goods
___ shift: move every letter three places along the alphabet
